    snapshot_path = ROOT / 'reviews/archive-critic-frozen-paths.json'
    raw = snapshot_path.read_bytes()
    metrics = a.metrics(raw)
    assert metrics['sha256'] == expected_sha256
    snapshot = json.loads(raw)
    assert snapshot['independent'] is True and snapshot['frozen'] is True
    assert snapshot['reviewer'] == reviewer == '/root/missing_world_audit'
    assert snapshot['builder_expected_manifest_sha256'] == a.metrics(content_bytes)['sha256']
    assert snapshot['candidate_tree'] == content['candidate_tree']
    assert snapshot['base_commit'] == content['base_commit'] == a.BASE
    assert snapshot['base_tree'] == content['base_tree'] == a.BASE_TREE
    assert snapshot['prefix'].rstrip('/') == content['prefix'].rstrip('/') == a.PREFIX
    assert snapshot['root_final_freeze_sha256'] == a.metrics((ROOT / 'final-freeze.json').read_bytes())['sha256']
    assert snapshot['package_critic_report_sha256'] == a.metrics((ROOT / 'reviews/archive-critic-final-package.json').read_bytes())['sha256']
    expected = {row['path']: row for row in content['files']}
    independent_rows = {row['path']: row for row in snapshot['files']}
    assert len(expected) == len(content['files'])
    assert len(independent_rows) == len(snapshot['files'])
    assert set(independent_rows) == set(expected)
    identity_fields = ['path', 'mode', 'type', 'bytes', 'sha256', 'git_blob_sha']
    for path, row in expected.items():
        assert all(independent_rows[path][key] == row[key] for key in identity_fields), path
    return {'source_file': str(snapshot_path.relative_to(ROOT)), **metrics,
            'exact_original_json_utf8': raw.decode('utf-8'),
            'exact_path_and_byte_identity_count': len(expected),
            'builder_expected_manifest_sha256': a.metrics(content_bytes)['sha256']}
